title: Scaffold, Lifts & Tall Work
short_answer: Job Start's Scaffold field is the plan. If the gear on site does not match it — or is unsafe — stop. This is a field card, not GVC's written fall-protection program.
summary: Job Start's Scaffold field is the plan. If the gear on site does not match it — or is unsafe — stop. This is a field card, not GVC's written fall-protection program.
plain_words: Match the packet: needed? whose? Do not borrow a lift you are not cleared to run. Do not climb incomplete scaffold "for a minute." Refusing bad access is the job; falling is not.
when_to_use: Before loading scaffold or running a lift on site
When Job Start scaffold note does not match gear present
Tall hang, finish, or ACT work requiring elevated access
prerequisites: Job Start Scaffold field read (and heater/cans if finishing at height)
Lead authorization for lift operation per GC and GVC rules

steps.body: Read Job Start Scaffold (and heater/cans if finishing). Confirm what should be on site.
Inspect before load: planks, rails, base — if incomplete, stop and call the lead.
Lifts: only with authorization / ticket the GC and GVC accept. No borrowed keys.
Material on scaffold: board weight tips scaffolds — stage sensibly; do not build a leaning tower of rock.
Finished work nearby: moving scaffold without protection damages punch (and becomes our repair).
Refuse unsafe access — Safety Orientation; escalate via Escalation Ladder.

warnings.title: Honesty bar
warnings.body: GVC's written fall-protection / lift programs (when formalized) live with the office. This page is orientation tied to the Job Start scaffold field and stop authority. It is not a substitute for OSHA compliance documents.

quality_checks.prompt: Scaffold on site matches Job Start Scaffold field
Planks, rails, and base inspected before load
Lift operation only with accepted authorization — no borrowed keys

common_mistakes.title: Minute on bad scaffold
common_mistakes.wrong: Climb incomplete scaffold "just for a minute"
common_mistakes.right: Stop and call the lead — refuse unsafe access
common_mistakes.why: Falls are not recoverable; punch damage is expensive

common_mistakes.title: Rock tower on planks
common_mistakes.wrong: Stack board weight until the scaffold tips
common_mistakes.right: Stage material sensibly; respect load limits
